units.source_text: “有这种事……你……是这里的主人吧？

en.t: "Something like this... you... you're the owner of this place, aren't you?
... You're not a little dog, are you...

units.source_text: 自由地进进出出，该不会有什么事吧！

en.t: Coming and going as you please, surely nothing bad will happen, right!

units.source_text: 要不就是你做过荒唐事，在村里人面前抬不起头来吧？”

en.t: Or else you must have done something absurd, and now you can't hold your head up in front of the villagers, can you?"
